name: remote-session-end-clears-a-working-turn
description: A remote session closes mid-turn: its SessionEnd arrives with no Stop before it. The working state clears at once and the transcript notes that the session ended before replying.
reason: SessionEnd is the only signal a session that dies mid-turn ever sends. Before it was handled, the light stayed amber after the terminal was closed.
source: DESIGN.md v1.10 'sessionEnd for a session we believed was working appends a .system entry "Claude session ended before replying." (label-prefixed by cwd)'; AppState.handleRemoteEvent(.sessionEnd)
